title: Deep learning on chest X-rays and clinical data screens for and stages COPD
summary: An ensemble deep learning model fused chest X-ray features and clinical parameters from 1055 participants. It reached an AUC of 0.969 in internal testing (n = 284) and 0.934 in an external set of 105 participants, better than clinical-only (0.963) or image-only (0.946) internal results. For severity, the AUC was 0.894 for three classes and 0.852 for five classes. The study is retrospective and the external set is small.
ai_technology: Ensemble deep learning and transfer learning models fusing chest X-ray images and clinical parameters
organization: Third Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University

evidence.tested: Trained on 666 participants, internal test on 284 and external test on 105.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and effect on diagnosis; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies COPD and predicts severity grades from chest X-ray images plus clinical data.
